status_history.basis: no ES event/trade sample, no verified C0 schedule; the precursor was not runnable from the repository

the frozen H3 OFI gross-markout measurement ran on the single admitted ESU3 window and returned KILL_MATERIALITY at the primary horizon (PRIMARY_HORIZON_GROSS_NOT_POSITIVE), scoped to that one window; the canonical corpus status change is only PROPOSED (M2/experiments/M2-BRIDGE-ES-H3-OFI/proposal.json)

mechanism: Signed order-flow imbalance: causal aggressive signed flow relative to contemporaneous executable ES liquidity, defined before outcome inspection.
decision_question: Does the causal H3 signal have gross displacement that exceeds the verified structural cost C0, and what unresolved cost C* would erase it, before any execution model or strategy evaluation?

data.current_status: Not owned or validated in the canonical repository; no purchase authorized by GOAL-001.

causal_state: Only messages and book/trade state available at the decision timestamp; no future messages, ex-post selection, oracle, or ML feature.
outcome: Side-signed midpoint or executable-price markout at fixed pre-registered H3 delays, with coverage and confidence intervals.
friction_comparator: Verified structural cost C0 (published exchange, clearing and mandatory venue fees for the named contract, priced for the candidate's execution style) plus a parameterized unresolved cost C1 covering broker/FCM/commission, spread and other account-specific components. C1 is declared as an explicit parameter with a stated range before the run and is never treated as zero; the precursor reports the break-even residual C* (the admissible unresolved cost at which the gross displacement vanishes). No generic or industry-imputed value may be substituted for C0 or hidden inside C1. Exact account-level broker/FCM cost is NOT required before this precursor: it is the gate before shadow/micro-live (UNK-0009-ECON-CME-MEASURED).
null: No conditional displacement beyond the unconditional signed markout, and no economically material difference from the predeclared null state.
primary_metric: Pooled gross markout less verified structural cost C0, reported against the declared C1 parameter range, with the break-even residual cost C* as the headline comparison; cost ledger, C1 range and horizons fixed before result inspection.
kill_criterion: Pre-registered pooled gross markout below C0 alone, or a break-even residual cost C* that is smaller than the lower bound of the declared C1 range, or a ratio below the project's admission bar; that bar and the C1 range must be fixed before data inspection in the successor run.
continuation_criterion: Causally valid positive gross headroom over C0 with a break-even residual cost C* that survives the declared C1 range and adequate coverage, and no timestamp, identity, or leakage failure; authorizes only a true M2 feasibility run, not execution.
account_cost_gate: The exact account-level broker/FCM/commission schedule for the intended account type is a mandatory gate before any shadow or micro-live run (UNK-0009-ECON-CME-MEASURED). A parameter value is not a substitute at that gate: realized execution economics cannot be measured against a parameter.

methodology_correction.replaces: exact account-level all-in cost required before the gross-materiality precursor
methodology_correction.with: causal admitted data + verified structural cost C0 + parameterized unresolved cost C1 (unknown never zero) + break-even residual cost C*
unchanged: mandatory fees and clearing charges as verified facts
methodology_correction.note: A methodology-stage correction, not a weakening of execution economics. No gate is passed, no data is admitted and no cost is verified by this correction.

stopping_condition: Stop after the fixed sample, state space and horizons are evaluated, or immediately if timestamp/identity validation fails. Do not run full M2 strategy evaluation as part of reselection.
external_prerequisites: operator jurisdiction/entity and intended account class
verified structural cost C0 schedule for the named contract (published exchange, clearing and mandatory venue fees)
declared parameterization of the unresolved cost C1 with its stated range (unknown never zero)

frozen_measurement.primary_rule: the verdict is computed at the primary horizon only; 5 s and 15 s are the reported term structure
frozen_measurement.state: x(t) = (aggressor-buy volume - aggressor-sell volume) in (t-1s, t] divided by the displayed top-of-book depth bid_sz+ask_sz at t; sign is the direction, no thresholds, a balanced or unquotable state is no position
frozen_measurement.outcome: side-signed midpoint markout in bps on the reconstructed top of book; no executable-price substitution

friction.c0: the measured observed-spread 1/2 S_entry + 1/2 S_exit term only; no verified account-independent mandatory CME charge exists in this environment
friction.c1: CME exchange, clearing and FCM amounts declared with UNKNOWN value (never zero) and reported as a scenario lattice, not as a fee

inference.method: instrument x contiguous 60 s block cluster bootstrap of the mean (M2/src/calculate.py::block_bootstrap_ci)
inference.significance: reported separately, never an input to the classification

frozen_measurement.scope_rule: one admitted 10-minute window can support at most a SAMPLE-SCOPED DEVELOPMENT KILL; a nominal SURVIVE_PROVISIONAL is downgraded to INDETERMINATE_COVERAGE and is never reported as survival
